notes.title: Q.U.B.E. Create v1.2.348 Fixes
notes.content:
Some minor fixes to the Q.U.B.E. Create sandbox in this update.

Future updates will mostly be minor fixes, with an occasional new feature thrown in. We're happy to take requests for further features and add them to the list of to-do - join our [url=https://discord.gg/ZSHz9kg9VV]Discord [/url]for more info!

- Removed a load of log spam.
- Changed name of Goal Area to Trigger Box.

Enjoy creating!

The Q.U.B.E. Team

notes.title: Q.U.B.E. Create fixes - v1.1.343
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42537451/47bf27c13032f0a522032df9212e5450bb5f64ba.png[/img]

Hi everyone! Here are some needed Q.U.B.E. Create priority fixes!
 
Future updates will mostly be minor fixes, with an occasional new feature thrown in. We're happy to take requests for further features - join our [url=https://discord.gg/ZSHz9kg9VV]Discord [/url]for more info!

- Fixed "Publish Success" message not disappearing
- Fixed pressing P in any published level would edit it.
- Fixed reset button not resetting laser cube spawners.
- Fixed previous level music carrying over to next loaded level. 
- Fixed no checks on updating published levels without exit doors and player spawn.
- Fixed preview image in publish menu.
- Fixed FOV issues after taking a preview image.
- Fixed goal area property window staying on screen.
- Fixed goal area not detecting player.
- Fixed goal area's "Win Level" checkbox not counting toward publish requirements.
- Fixed goal area connection lines.
- Fixed lighting settings not resetting when creating a new level.
- Added global shadow setting in global light setting properties. Increasing this value fixes any light bleeding issues for those super dark levels. 

Enjoy creating!

The Q.U.B.E. Team

notes.title: Q.U.B.E. Create v1.0 Release
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42537451/47bf27c13032f0a522032df9212e5450bb5f64ba.png[/img]

[h1]Q.U.B.E. Create
[/h1]

[b]Build v1.0 just deployed these changes to Steam
[/b]

Q.U.B.E. Create is now fully featured and has reached v1.0 release! ːsteamhappyː 
Future updates will mostly be minor fixes, with an occasional new feature thrown in. We're still happy to take requests for further features - join our [url=https://discord.gg/ZSHz9kg9VV]Discord [/url]for more info!

Here is the list of latest changes: 

NEW FEATURE: - Added Physics Robot.
NEW FEATURE: - Undo function. Users can now Undo an action, or property setting by hitting Z.
NEW FEATURE: - Publish menu: Added in game screenshot feature for preview image selection.


- Fixed collision issue on projectile with turret.
- Fixed Magnet (from QUBE 1) displaying debug sphere when in play mode.
- Fixed World Magnet Manager still being hit by weapon when in Play mode. 
- Fixed Kill Fence's sound box always being selectable, causing blocking issues when trying to select anything else within it's radius. Also made sure it's hidden during Play. 
- Fixed deleting a magnet (QUBE 1) would not remove the connection line. 
- Optimized Forcefield.
- Placeable Surface scaling optimizations.
- Added Editor Controls pause/main menu screen. 
- Added new end of level UI.
- Fixed exit door not working after being used once in an editor session.
- Fixed exit teleporter not working after being used once in an editor session, added delays between some effects.
- Fixed made entire length of cable connector selectable with mouse click.
- Fixed main/pause menu overlaying issues with submenus.

notes.title: Q.U.B.E. Create Update v0.5.33.298
notes.content:
[h1]Q.U.B.E. Create
[/h1]

[b]Build v0.5.33.298 just deployed these changes to Steam
[/b]
NEW FEATURE: - Added Gizmo scaling options. Cycle through R to toggle. You can now scale a number of objects in the editor.
NEW FEATURE: - Added Reset button. Attach to puzzle objects to reset them. 
NEW FEATURE: - Player Death option in World Settings menu.
NEW FEATURE: - Added Kill Fence. This will instantly kill the player if Player Death option is enabled and player touches. 
NEW FEATURE: - Added Turret.  This will kill the player after 3 impacts if Player Death option is enabled. 

Added colour palette to change cable connector properties.
Added elevator target display.
Fixed bugs with laser redirector, loops, and multiple input sources.
Fixed bugs when copying light panels. Their properties are now copied too.
Fixed chamber door staying open sometimes.

KNOWN ISSUES:

The Force Field has some performance issues right now.

notes.title: Q.U.B.E. Create update v0.4.32.271
notes.content:
Update notes for Q.U.B.E. Create v0.4.32.271

NEW FEATURE: - Added music player selection options for custom levels. Accessible from the World Properties menu. Songs will preview when clicking on them. Songs will only play during Play Mode or in Published levels.
- Updated overall lighting, and updated shadows so they aren't so dark overall. 
- Added Credits screen in menu.
- Updated menus with consistent headers & styles. 
- Added object name text UI when an object is selected.
- Goal area fixes.
- Moving component fixes.
- Added basic chamber door that can be activated/deactivated by weight switches etc.
- Added actor culling distance ranging from 12000 to 20000 units to aid performance.
- Added light culling to aid performance. 
- Turned off casting of shadows by default on point lights, spot lights, and light panels. Added option to cast shadows on individual lights.
- Added lighting options in light panels.
- Changed orange light panel to be a cracked/broken down styled panel. 
- Weight switch attachment beam fix & optimisation.
- Fixed collision issue with Lift.
- Added code methods to change material colours of light panels. 
- Added colour picker to geometry and modular meshes. 
- Added colour picker to lights and light panel options. 
- Added teleporter as a method to end the level. 
- Potential fix for World/Local Space UI getting stuck when loading up a new level. 

We hope you enjoy the latest updates to Q.U.B.E. Create! Keep the feedback and suggestions rolling in our Discord: [url=https://discord.gg/ZSHz9kg9VV]https://discord.gg/ZSHz9kg9VV[/url]

Remember to share content on socials and use #qubegame to tag!

Thanks again!
The QUBE Team

notes.title: Q.U.B.E. Create update v0.1.28.218
notes.content:
Q.U.B.E. Create v0.1.28.218 is now live on Steam for all users that own Q.U.B.E. 10th Anniversary!

Patch notes are as follows:

- Light panels emit more light.
- Fixed World Magnets(Classic Magnets): Activated magnets doesn't affect newly spawned physics actors. Magnet range system didn't work correctly. Physics actors now disable when out of the range.  Magnets now turn off when returning to Edit mode from Play mode. 
- Prevented copying of Magnet Managers due to complications with pairings. The game now displays a failure message when attempting to copy.  
- NEW FEATURE: Added feature to update existing steam published levels. 
- NEW FEATURE: Added methods to change, save and load material colours for walls via Object Properties window.
- Fixed Screen being unselectable after initial creation.
- Fixed Elevator being unselectable after using it. 
- Fixed Physics Actor being too "fragile".
- Fixed new objects not getting selected when creating and cloning. 
- Potential fix for button materials not being visible.
- NEW FEATURE: Added Object List menu.
- Fixed lift/text properties menus not toggling off from keybind and other menus being toggled on.
- Various code optimizations.

notes.title: Q.U.B.E. Create enters public BETA!
notes.content:
No need for a closed beta sign up key! Everyone who owns Q.U.B.E. 10th Anniversary can now access Q.U.B.E. Create! 

[h2]Important Notes
[/h2]
This is still a early access build of the level editor and will contain bugs and even crash at times. There is an auto save functionality implemented which you can configure in the Settings menu. Please save your levels regularly to avoid loss. Please report any bugs/crashes to us. Details below.

[h2]Bug/Crash Reporting
[/h2]
There is a dedicated Q.U.B.E. Create Bug Reporting channel in Discord and on the Steam Community Hub discussion board. Please post any issues in either of those channels. 

[h2]General Feedback
[/h2]
You can post general feedback and suggestions to the Create Feedback channels in either Discord or the Community Hub. 

[h2]Sharing Content
[/h2]
You are completely free to share screenshots and videos of your custom levels online, in the Community Hub, and on Discord. Tag [b]#qubegame[/b] on socials! 

[b]Join the Discord:[/b] https://discord.gg/ZSHz9kg9VV

notes.title: Update v1.2 - Keybinding fixes, level design fixes, and new playable level!
notes.content:
[h1]Q.U.B.E. 10th Anniversary v1.2[/h1]

We have listened to the community, taking on feedback and fixing issues. We'd like to thank everyone who has bought the game and joined in on the Discord server to express their feedback and opinions. Here's what we've changed in v1.2:

[h2]v1.2 Updates: - [/h2]

[h3]Bug Fixes - [/h3]

[list]
[*] Fixed floating panels in Sector 8. There was a misplaced panel floating in the middle of Sector 8!
[*] Fixed issues with key bindings. Keybindings would not rebind correctly! 
[*] Fixed issue with Reset To Defaults in the options menu. 
[/list]

[h3]Level Added - [/h3]

We took on the feedback from many of the community that loved a classic puzzle that was originally excluded from the game, and we recreated it. We have added [b]Tough Going[/b] playable from the Extras menu - it's a blast from the past that we hope you'll enjoy, and not pull your hair out too much. 

Until next time!

- The Q.U.B.E. team.
Toxic Games.

notes.title: Update 1.1 - Quality of Life, Bug Fixes and an Additional Option.
notes.content:
[h1]Q.U.B.E. 10th Anniversary v1.1[/h1]

What an exciting 4 weeks it has been, first off we'd like to thank all of you for your feedback and support this far - we're still dedicated to making sure the game is everything you want.

[h2]v1.1 Updates: - [/h2]

[b]Bug Fixes -[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug that was causing issues in the Sector 8 end slate user interface.
[*]Fixed a bug in which starting a new game in Sector 8 would not reset the collectable items.
[*]Fixed various user interface text issues.
[/list]

[b]Quality of Life -[/b]
[list]
[*]Development console key moved from Tab to the ` (backtick) key.
[*]Reset puzzle sound effect changed.
[*]Minor level design updates and fixes in various places throughout sector 8.
[*]Increased default look sensitivity.
[/list]

[b]Additions -[/b]
We've added an option to enable or disable the outline around cubes that can be interacted with, when hovering over them.

Thank you again for all the feedback, both positivity and negative - it all helps us make the game the best possible and we really appreciate the reviews coming in so far! 

Until next time!

- Rushy,
Toxic Games.

notes.title: Q.U.B.E. 10th Anniversary - Out Now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42537451/243f2a2af9e059c018f9b9de4dda054e948a9926.png[/img]
[h1]Well everybody, it’s the day we’ve all been waiting for![/h1]

Prepare to experience Q.U.B.E. in a whole new way, re-built from the ground up. 

[h2]Q.U.B.E. 10th Anniversary will include [/h2]
[list]
[*] Q.U.B.E. - The original - The 2012 version of the game with improved visuals, new puzzles and gameplay tweaks from player feedback.

[*] Q.U.B.E. Director’s Cut - The 2014 version of the game with a voice-over narrative and revised soundtrack.

[*] Sector 8 - A whole new chapter to the game, unlocked after completing the campaign. This provides 4-6 hours of brand new puzzle gameplay.

[*] Fresh visuals - With the game entirely rebuilt from the ground up and embrace new technologies such as Raytracing and DLSS.

[*] Brand New Developer Commentary - The dev team reminisces about how they made the game, all of those years ago.

[*] Assorted Extras - Screenshots, concept art, fully playable soundtracks in the menus, and other trinkets from the making of the game.
[/list][h2]Join the developer steam live stream at 4pm GMT+00![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42537451/e1ddd97afe86cb9bc1bdcfdf65a9c62c30f0033a.png[/img]
Join the live launch event at 4pm GMT on the Q.U.B.E. 10th Anniversary Steam page where the development team will be here to hang out, answer your questions and celebrate the release of [b]Q.U.B.E. 10th Anniversary![/b] 

- Toxic Games

notes.title: The time has almost come!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4959436/58c74a2389bf660000e2323b4dc4367f7e66761b.png[/img]
After many many months of passion, persistence & drive, we’re now less than 24 hours away from the release of our new title - Q.U.B.E. 10th Anniversary.

Q.U.B.E. is a series that holds a special place in our hearts, as the title that birthed our Game Development careers all those years ago, we could only think of one way to celebrate the epic adventure that has been the last 10 years.

This title is more than a game for us. It is an experience that has taken us around the world, spawned friendships to last a lifetime, taught us invaluable lessons and we owe it all to you.
The fans. The community.

[url=https://discord.com/invite/ANPQ2w9VEd][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4959436/36a1a268c7998ea97c34b344239055db928a0222.png[/img]
[/url]
We hope you are ready to embark on this next chapter with us and we look forward to hearing your feedback.

We’ll see you tomorrow at 2pm GMT!
- Toxic Games.
